title: NodeDef icon
description: Either one of PG3/IoX's predefined icon names, or a URI to a custom icon image. Restructured from iox-vscode-plugin's icon.schema.json (a flat oneOf enum with no Dynamic-Profiles-dialect changes needed -- icon names are a platform-level concept, not an ioxplugin-specific one) plus common.node.schema.json's icon field shape (predefined-name-or-uri). Uses `anyOf`, not the source's `oneOf`: `format: uri` is unenforced without an attached format-checker (jsonschema's default), so every plain string would validate under BOTH branches, and `oneOf` requires exactly one match -- `anyOf` (at least one) is what's actually intended here. Referenced by nodedef.schema.json's `icon`/`customicon` fields per design/developers/plugin_model.md §3 (NodeDef object), which documents `icon` as 'UI icon identifier. Ref: https://developer.isy.io/docs/API/IoX/icons' and `customicon` as 'Future use' -- note src/nucore/nodedef.py's parser currently collapses both spec keys into one `customicon` field (see schemas/README.md).
